regions.merged_text: We are having "chapter here started early this A.M. - Election of a new Provincial and definitors, etc. It will probably be a week or more before its all over. We have close to fifty priests besides brothers attending .... . July 15. I had a "free Mass" Today which I offered quite specially for God's guidance of the Chapter and for dear Brother James. Am sending your letter on to Fr. Maurice. He seems doing well. Will probably go down to see him before long .... God's grace to all!
